title: Naming persons voted for in ballots, separate ballots.
bodyText: The electors shall name in their ballots the person voted for as president, and in separate ballots the person voted for as vice president.
bodyHtml: §14-29  Naming persons voted for in ballots, separate ballots.  The electors shall name in their ballots the person voted for as president, and in separate ballots the person voted for as vice president. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2]
